shared_hypothesis: Bounded router dynamics may preserve the two-FFN sparse-over-dense advantage while increasing the learned-over-frozen gap and randomized-route dependence.

shared_falsifier: No bounded router control improves learned-minus-frozen or route reliance while preserving the dense advantage and noncollapsed expert use.
